description.p: Listen to the audiobooks in your own Audible library. Skald speaks the same protocol as Audible's phone apps, so your place syncs both ways: pause here, carry on on another device.
Books download once and play offline. Chapters, playback speed, and your progress in each book.

ul.li: Signs in on Amazon's own page; your password never passes through Skald.
Only your own account's books: it is not a way around buying them.
